title: O Jamesy let me up out of this pooh sweets of sin
html_source: In this line the reader can infer that James Joyce is actually breaking the 4th wall with his character Molly, as he writes her to beg him to stop making her think about things she describes as a “pooh.” This meta point in Molly’s stream of consciousness is just one more tidbit of information to add to James Joyce’s notoriety for making critics and analysts think hard on his works.
